controls.title: Secure Architecture and Threat Modeling
controls.description: The application is designed against a documented threat model that drives security requirements.

controls.title: Password Security
controls.description: Passwords meet minimum length and complexity policy and are not silently truncated.

controls.title: General Authenticator Security
controls.description: Anti-automation controls defend authentication against credential stuffing and brute force.

controls.title: Session Termination
controls.description: Sessions are invalidated on logout and expire after an idle and absolute timeout.

controls.title: General Access Control Design
controls.description: Access control is enforced on a trusted server-side layer for every request.

controls.title: Input Validation
controls.description: All untrusted input is validated against a positive specification before use.

controls.title: Output Encoding and Injection Prevention
controls.description: Database queries use parameterization to prevent SQL and other query injection.

controls.title: Cross-Site Scripting Prevention
controls.description: Context-aware output encoding neutralizes cross-site scripting in rendered responses.

controls.title: Cryptographic Algorithms
controls.description: Cryptographic modules use approved algorithms and fail securely.

controls.title: Random Values
controls.description: Security-sensitive random values are generated with a cryptographically secure generator.

controls.title: Log Content and Error Handling
controls.description: Errors are handled without leaking sensitive data and security events are logged.

controls.title: General Data Protection
controls.description: Sensitive data is cached, retained, and transmitted only as strictly necessary.

controls.title: Communications Security
controls.description: All inbound and outbound traffic uses authenticated, up-to-date TLS.

controls.title: Malicious Code Search
controls.description: Application source is free of backdoors, time bombs, and unauthorized code.

controls.title: File Execution and Path Security
controls.description: User-supplied filenames and paths cannot escape the intended directory.

controls.title: Security Requirements
controls.description: Security requirements are captured and prioritized alongside functional requirements.

controls.title: Threat Assessment
controls.description: Threats and abuse cases are systematically identified during design.

controls.title: Secure Architecture
controls.description: Security-by-design principles and vetted technologies are applied to the architecture.

controls.title: Secure Build
controls.description: Builds are automated, repeatable, and validate the security of dependencies.

controls.title: Security Testing
controls.description: Automated and manual security testing is performed against the application.

controls.title: Incident Management
controls.description: Security incidents are detected, triaged, and responded to with a defined process.

controls.title: Build and Deployment
controls.description: Build and deployment pipelines are automated and produce reproducible artifacts.

controls.title: Dynamic Depth for Applications
controls.description: Running applications are tested dynamically for security weaknesses.

controls.title: Static Depth for Applications
controls.description: Source code is statically analyzed for security defects on each change.

controls.title: Implementation of Patch Management
controls.description: Known-vulnerable components are patched within a defined service-level window.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Security-relevant events are logged centrally and monitored.

controls.title: Security Culture and Training
controls.description: Teams receive ongoing secure-development training and threat awareness.

nist-800-53.name: NIST SP 800-53 Security and Privacy Controls

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: The system enforces approved authorizations for logical access to resources.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.description: The organization grants only the access required for users and processes to do their work.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.description: Users are uniquely identified and authenticated before accessing the system.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Authenticators such as passwords and keys are managed across their lifecycle.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: The system protects the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: The system uses FIPS-validated or NSA-approved cryptography to protect information.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: The system protects the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: The organization identifies, reports, and corrects information system flaws.

controls.title: Information Input Validation
controls.description: The system checks the validity of information inputs to prevent injection and tampering.

controls.title: Error Handling
controls.description: The system handles errors without revealing information exploitable by adversaries.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.description: The organization logs the events necessary to support security monitoring and forensics.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.description: Audit information and tooling are protected from unauthorized access and modification.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.description: The system is configured to provide only essential capabilities and disables unused services.

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.description: The organization scans for vulnerabilities and remediates discovered weaknesses.

controls.title: Define Security Requirements
controls.description: Security requirements for software development are defined and maintained.

controls.title: Secure Toolchain
controls.description: Development toolchains are deployed and operated with security configurations.

controls.title: Protect All Forms of Code
controls.description: Source code and configuration are stored with access control and integrity protection.

controls.title: Provide Mechanism to Verify Software Integrity
controls.description: Released software is signed or hashed so consumers can verify its integrity.

controls.title: Archive and Protect Each Release
controls.description: Each software release is archived along with its provenance data.

controls.title: Reuse Secure Software Components
controls.description: Existing well-secured components are reused instead of writing new code where feasible.

controls.title: Create Source Code Adhering to Secure Practices
controls.description: Source code is written following secure coding practices that avoid known weaknesses.

controls.title: Configure Compilation and Build to Improve Security
controls.description: Compilation, interpretation, and build processes are configured to harden the output.

controls.title: Review and Analyze Human-Readable Code
controls.description: Human-readable code is reviewed or statically analyzed to find vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Test Executable Code
controls.description: Executable code is dynamically tested to identify vulnerabilities at runtime.

controls.title: Configure Software with Secure Defaults
controls.description: Software ships with secure default settings for deployment and use.

controls.title: Identify and Confirm Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Vulnerabilities are continuously monitored, identified, and confirmed.

controls.title: Assess and Remediate Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Confirmed vulnerabilities are prioritized, remediated, and verified.

controls.title: AI Governance and Accountability
controls.description: Policies and accountability structures govern the AI system across its lifecycle.

controls.title: AI System Context and Risk Mapping
controls.description: The intended context, capabilities, and risks of the AI system are documented.

controls.title: AI Security and Resilience
controls.description: The AI system is evaluated for security, including prompt injection and adversarial robustness.

controls.title: AI Data Privacy
controls.description: Privacy risks from training and inference data are evaluated and mitigated.

controls.title: AI Risk Treatment and Monitoring
controls.description: Identified AI risks are treated, and the system is monitored for emerging issues.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information are established and applied.

controls.title: Secure Authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures restrict access to systems.

controls.title: Use of Cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including key management, are defined.

controls.title: Application Security Requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements are identified for applications under development.

controls.title: Secure Coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles are applied to software development to avoid vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Monitoring Activities
controls.description: Networks, systems, and applications are monitored for anomalous behavior.

controls.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Technical vulnerabilities in information systems are identified and addressed.

controls.title: Logical Access Controls
controls.description: Logical access security software and infrastructure restrict access to protected assets.

controls.title: Boundary Protection and Encryption in Transit
controls.description: The system protects information transmitted across boundaries from unauthorized access.

controls.title: Restricting Data Transmission and Storage
controls.description: Data is restricted and protected during transmission, movement, and removal.

controls.title: Vulnerability Detection and Monitoring
controls.description: Procedures detect and monitor configuration changes and new vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Security Event Monitoring
controls.description: The system is monitored to detect and analyze anomalies and security events.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.description: Changes to infrastructure, data, and software follow a controlled change process.

controls.title: Data Protection by Design and by Default
controls.description: Data protection measures are built into processing by design and applied by default.

controls.title: Security of Processing
controls.description: Appropriate technical measures, including encryption, ensure a level of security for personal data.

controls.title: Notification of a Personal Data Breach
controls.description: Personal data breaches are detected and reported to the supervisory authority promptly.

controls.title: Principles Relating to Processing of Personal Data
controls.description: Personal data is processed lawfully, with integrity, confidentiality, and minimization.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: High-risk processing is assessed for its impact on the rights of data subjects.

controls.title: Prevent Common Software Attacks
controls.description: Software-engineering techniques prevent injection, tampering, and other common attacks.

controls.title: Patch Known Vulnerabilities
controls.description: All system components are protected from known vulnerabilities by installing security patches.

controls.title: Strong Cryptography for Transmission
controls.description: Strong cryptography protects cardholder data during transmission over open networks.

controls.title: Protect Stored Account Data
controls.description: Stored primary account numbers are rendered unreadable through strong cryptography.

controls.title: Strong Authentication for Users
controls.description: All user access is authenticated with strong authentication factors.

controls.title: Restrict Access by Need to Know
controls.description: Access to system components and data is restricted to least privilege required by job function.

controls.title: Audit Logs for Security Events
controls.description: Audit logs capture security events to support detection and forensic analysis.

controls.title: Risk Analysis and Information System Security Policies
controls.description: Entities adopt policies on risk analysis and the security of information systems.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.description: Entities maintain capabilities to detect, handle, and respond to security incidents.

controls.title: Supply Chain Security
controls.description: Entities address security risks in supplier relationships and the software supply chain.

controls.title: Security in Network and Information Systems Acquisition and Development
controls.description: Security is built into the acquisition, development, and maintenance of systems.

controls.title: Effectiveness Assessment of Cybersecurity Measures
controls.description: Policies and procedures assess the effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures.

controls.title: Cyber Hygiene and Training
controls.description: Basic cyber-hygiene practices and cybersecurity training are provided.

controls.title: Cryptography and Encryption
controls.description: Policies on the use of cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption are established.

controls.title: Access Control and Asset Management
controls.description: Human-resources security, access control policies, and asset management are enforced.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication and Secured Communications
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication and secured communication systems are used where appropriate.

controls.title: Reporting Obligations
controls.description: Significant incidents are reported to the competent authority within defined deadlines.

controls.title: ICT Risk Management Framework
controls.description: Financial entities maintain a sound ICT risk-management framework.

controls.title: Protection and Prevention
controls.description: ICT systems are protected with security tools, policies, and encryption.

controls.title: Detection of Anomalous Activities
controls.description: Mechanisms promptly detect anomalous activities and ICT-related incidents.

controls.title: ICT-Related Incident Management Process
controls.description: A process manages, classifies, and responds to ICT-related incidents.

controls.title: Digital Operational Resilience Testing
controls.description: Entities test ICT systems and applications for operational resilience.

controls.title: ICT Third-Party Risk Management
controls.description: Risks from ICT third-party service providers are managed throughout the relationship.

controls.title: Secure by Design and Default
controls.description: Products with digital elements are designed, developed, and produced to be secure by default.

controls.title: Delivered Without Known Exploitable Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Products are made available without known exploitable vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Protection of Confidentiality
controls.description: Products protect the confidentiality of data through encryption at rest and in transit.

controls.title: Protection from Unauthorized Access
controls.description: Products protect against unauthorized access through appropriate control mechanisms.

controls.title: Vulnerability Handling and SBOM
controls.description: Manufacturers identify and document vulnerabilities and components, including a software bill of materials.

controls.title: Security Updates
controls.description: Security updates are provided to address vulnerabilities without delay.

controls.title: Take Ownership of Customer Security Outcomes
controls.description: Manufacturers take ownership of security outcomes rather than shifting risk to customers.

controls.title: Embrace Radical Transparency and Accountability
controls.description: Manufacturers disclose vulnerabilities with complete CWE and CVE information.

controls.title: Build Organizational Structure for Secure by Design
controls.description: Leadership establishes structures that prioritize security across development.

controls.title: Eliminate Memory Safety Vulnerabilities
controls.description: Products adopt memory-safe languages and patterns to eliminate memory-safety defects.

controls.title: Use Parameterized Queries
controls.description: Database access uses parameterized queries to eliminate SQL injection by construction.

controls.title: Sanitize and Validate Inputs
controls.description: All inputs are validated and output is encoded to eliminate injection classes.

controls.title: Enable Multi-Factor Authentication by Default
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication is provided and enabled by default for users.

controls.title: Eliminate Default Passwords
controls.description: Products ship without shared default passwords and require unique credentials.

controls.title: Provide Secure Logging at No Extra Charge
controls.description: Detailed security logs are available to customers without an additional licensing fee.

controls.title: Reduce the Burden of Security Patches
controls.description: Products make security updates easy to apply and reduce the cost of patching.

controls.title: Establish a Vulnerability Disclosure Program
controls.description: A coordinated vulnerability-disclosure program allows researchers to report issues.

controls.title: Track and Reduce Recurring Vulnerability Classes
controls.description: Manufacturers analyze CWE trends to eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities.

eo-14028.name: US Executive Order 14028 on Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity

controls.title: Secure Software Development Environments
controls.description: Software is developed in administratively separate, secured build environments.

controls.title: Automated Vulnerability Detection
controls.description: Automated tools maintain trusted source code and check for known vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Provide a Software Bill of Materials
controls.description: Producers provide a software bill of materials for each product.

controls.title: Attestation of Conformity to Secure Practices
controls.description: Software producers attest to conformity with secure software-development practices.

controls.title: Adopt Multi-Factor Authentication and Encryption
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication and encryption for data at rest and in transit are adopted.

fda-524b.name: FDA Section 524B Cybersecurity in Medical Devices

controls.title: Secure Product Development Framework
controls.description: A secure product development framework governs the device's cybersecurity over its lifecycle.

controls.title: Software Bill of Materials
controls.description: The device is accompanied by a software bill of materials covering commercial and open-source components.

controls.title: Postmarket Vulnerability Monitoring
controls.description: Postmarket processes monitor, identify, and address device vulnerabilities and exploits.

controls.title: Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure and Patching
controls.description: A coordinated disclosure process and timely updates remediate device vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Controls and Encryption
controls.description: The device implements access control, authentication, and encryption to protect health data.
